name: OSS_BALANCE_MANAGEMENT_T
description: Following table is used to capture balance inforamtion of subscription product.

columns.name: BALANCE_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier subscription balance management usage.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture subscription product id.

columns.name: OPERATION
columns.description: Field used to capture subscrion lifecycle operation.

columns.name: ACTION
columns.description: Field used to capture create or delete action.

columns.name: EVERGREEN_YN
columns.description: Field used to capture evergreen property of subscription product.

columns.name: MAX_CHARGE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture charge definition id which has maximum charge period.

columns.name: MAX_CHARGE_PERIOD
columns.description: This field tracks the max charge period for evergreen subscription product.

columns.name: MAX_CHARGE_PERIOD_BASE_UOM
columns.description: This field tracks the max charge period base unitofmeasure for evergreen subscription product.

columns.name: MAX_CHARGE_PERIOD_CONV_RATE
columns.description: This field tracks the max charge period conversion rate for evergreen subscription product.

columns.name: PROCESSED_UNTIL_DATE
columns.description: Field used to capture the date, when billing schedule generated.

columns.name: ENTITLEMENTS_UNTIL_DATE
columns.description: Field used to capture the date, upto entitlements schedule generated.

columns.name: REQUESTED_ENT_UNTIL_DATE
columns.description: Field used to capture the date from extend entitlement schedule job, upto entitlements schedule generated.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Field used to capture status of balance management interface record.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: This field tracks the process status of balance manage transaction.

columns.name: NEXT_PROCESS
columns.description: This field tracks the next process of balance manage transaction.

columns.name: BALANCE_REGISTER_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture balance register id.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the Identifier of rate plan.

columns.name: REQUESTED_RATE_PLAN_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the Identifier of requested rate plan .

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Tracks the transaction sequence for given balance management transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Tracks the transaction date for given balance management transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Tracks the transaction conflict id for given balance management transaction.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_INSTANCE_CREATE_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the completion of rate plan determinant creation for specific rate plan instance.

columns.name: MASTER_CRITERIA_CREATE_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the completion of master criteria creation for determinant charge rule for specific rate plan instance.

columns.name: USAGE_UNIT_RATING_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the completion of unit event rating for specific subscription product.

columns.name: UPDATE_PRICE_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the update of  unit rating charge for specific subscription product.

columns.name: ENTITLEMENTS_SCHEDULE_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the scheduling of entitlement for specific subscription product.

columns.name: EVERGREEN_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the future scheduling of entitlement for evergreen subscription product.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the parent transaction id for given balance management transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_LABEL
columns.description: This field tracks the transaction label for given balance management transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
